description: Use visually independent HD bark elaborations after overlapping crops were rejected, add attached needle sprays at every branch tier, and clone the corrected tree with a palette-only dark foliage grade preserving geometry and alpha.
changes: Archive 1.3.2 before edits; retain normal and dark as separate IDs
Generate three independent bark panels and an HD front requested subsequently; preserve per-face continuous vertical UV phase
Add 208 small attached needle sprays across all 104 bough pairs
Split native tree into static Wood 240 nodes, Wind Canopy 229, Wind Needles 208
Explicitly set all shapes to standard shading, with no emitted light
Transfer the imagegen dark study palette while preserving original needle contours and shading; protect bark and warm woody pixels
advantages: All four bark faces have visibly independent motifs
Identical normal/dark geometry and alpha checked byte-for-byte
Prior versions and original grass texture preserved
disadvantages: More foliage geometry and one extra prefab component increase rendering cost; FPS not benchmarked
Generated bark is an interpretation of the concept, not original RGB
User owns final client shadow and visual review
test_results: Six components pass Hytale Blockbench validation
677 nodes in each assembly; normal/dark native model files identical
Original leaf texture retained in normal; dark alpha and bark unchanged
15 assets and 44 placements verified at creation and after reload, with rotations, Wind packets and no emitted light
Only ConceptPixels resources and manifest changed; old trees/grass preserved
Backed-up closed QA world installed; production map not written
